header.job: Onboarding (product sign-up), as a rewrite of the live Trial onboarding flow
header.trigger: Metric: Started Trial (the app sends it when a trial starts)
header.goal: the first booking through the booking page during the 14-day trial

fix_first.action: Record marketing consent at trial sign-up (a consent box stored as Klaviyo email consent), and give email 7 the flow filter 'can receive email marketing'. Emails 1 to 6 are service emails about the trial and can go to everyone.

account_readiness.found: Sender Example Booking Software <hello@example.com>, reply-to support@example.com. Postal address set. Time zone America/New_York, currency USD, industry Software / SaaS.
account_readiness.means: The footer can print the saved address, and replies to the PS lines reach a support mailbox.

account_readiness.found: 16 metrics. Started Trial: yes (API). Product events: Connected Calendar, Published Booking Page, Received First Booking. Placed Order: yes (API). Started Checkout, Viewed Product, Added to Cart: no. Test-named metrics: 0.
account_readiness.means: The flow can start on Started Trial, skip people who already connected a calendar or published their page, and stop the activation emails once Received First Booking fires. There is no event for reminders or deposits, so emails 4 and 5 go to everyone still in the flow.

account_readiness.found: 5 flows, 4 live. Trial onboarding is live on Started Trial.
account_readiness.means: A live flow already does this job, so this is a rewrite of Trial onboarding, not a second flow: two onboarding flows on one trigger would email every trial twice.

account_readiness.source: get_flow_report (90 days, conversion metric Received First Booking)
account_readiness.found: email 1 Welcome to your trial: 2,301 delivered, click 9.8%, first booking 13.5%, unsubscribe 0.2%; email 2 Connect your calendar: 2,233 delivered, click 7.1%, first booking 9.2%, unsubscribe 0.3%; email 3 Turn on reminders: 0 delivered, click 0.0%, first booking 0.0%, unsubscribe 0.0%; email 4 Take deposits: 2,044 delivered, click 2.9%, first booking 3.0%, unsubscribe 1.3%; email 5 Your trial ends in 3 days: 1,954 delivered, click 6.4%, first booking 2.2%, unsubscribe 0.5%
account_readiness.means: Rewrite first Take deposits (lowest click rate, 2.9%, and unsubscribes 1.3%, above 1%). Turn on reminders reached 0 people in 90 days: the flow skips it today.

account_readiness.found: 21 email campaigns, 21 with 500 or more delivered; average click rate 3.1%. Top 3 by click rate: Reminder text templates you can copy (4.7%, Thursday 15:00 America/New_York); 9 ways to cut no-shows before the holidays (4.5%, Tuesday 10:00 America/New_York); How a clinic filled its cancellation gaps (4.4%, Tuesday 10:00 America/New_York).
account_readiness.means: The winners teach a practical how-to with something to copy or use, kept short, sent on a Tuesday morning (2 of the top 3). Klaviyo reports carry no subject lines, so ask for the winners' subjects to compare angles.

account_readiness.found: 6 lists (5 real, 1 QA list); Trial sign-ups is single_opt_in. 4 segments, including Active customers (Placed Order at least once, no cancellation since).
account_readiness.means: The flow starts on the Started Trial metric. People who have paid leave through the flow filter; no extra exclusion segment is needed.

account_readiness.found: 3 templates; House template 2026 has the unsubscribe tag and the address tag. 1 test-named template, not used.
account_readiness.means: Every draft below uses House template 2026, so the footer is already right.

account_readiness.found: 1 real coupon (ANNUAL15: 15% off the first year of an annual plan).
account_readiness.means: Not used: the user said no discounts.

subject_options.benefit: No double bookings from day one
subject_options.question: Which calendar runs your day?

emails.preview: Connect it once and clients only see the times you can take.
emails.body:
Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

Your trial is ready. Three steps get your first booking in: connect your calendar, publish your booking page, and share the link.

Start with the calendar. With two-way sync, busy times in Google Calendar block bookings, and every new booking lands in your calendar, so nobody books you on top of something else.

cta.to: the calendar settings page in the app

emails.ps: Stuck on any step? Reply to this email and tell us where.

compliance_check.check: Postal address in every commercial email
compliance_check.evidence: The account address is set and House template 2026 prints it with {{ organization.full_address }}.
House template 2026 has {% unsubscribe %} next to {% manage_preferences %}; every draft uses it.
From Example Booking Software <hello@example.com>, replies to support@example.com; every subject describes its email.
Emails 1 to 6 are setup help for the trial the person started. Email 7 is a plan reminder about the same product, sent only to people who can receive marketing.

Trials come from the US, UK and Canada (the user). The flow starts on a metric, not a list, and the Trial sign-ups list is single_opt_in, so UK and Canadian trials have no recorded marketing consent in Klaviyo.
compliance_check.action: Record marketing consent at trial sign-up (a consent box stored as Klaviyo email consent), and give email 7 the flow filter 'can receive email marketing'. Emails 1 to 6 are service emails about the trial and can go to everyone.
Confirm in Klaviyo that unsubscribes are suppressed at once.

compliance_check.evidence: 21 subject lines and 7 preview lines: 0 with spam-style wording ('free', 'act now', '!!', money claims) and 0 fake 'Re:' or 'Fwd:' subjects. Subjects, previews and bodies: 0 ALL-CAPS words. Longest subject 41 characters. The drafts are text with one button each and no images.
Domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) isn't readable through the API.
compliance_check.action: Check in Klaviyo that example.com is an authenticated sending domain; the flow sends to about 770 new trials a month.

build_steps: Leave Trial onboarding running for now. In Klaviyo, clone it as 'Trial onboarding v2' in draft, with the trigger 'Metric: Started Trial'.
Add the flow filter 'Placed Order zero times since starting this flow'.
Add the 7 emails in order with time delays of 1 day, 2 days, 2 days, 2 days, 3 days, 2 days between them (email 1 sends at once).

Add the skip filters: email 1 'Connected Calendar zero times since starting this flow', email 2 'Published Booking Page zero times since starting this flow', emails 3 and 6 'Received First Booking zero times since starting this flow', email 7 'can receive email marketing'.
Pick House template 2026 for every email, or paste the copy into it.
Preview every email, send yourself a test from Klaviyo, then set v2 live and set Trial onboarding to manual on the same day, so no trial gets both.

measurement.per_email: click rate, conversion rate to Received First Booking, unsubscribe rate and spam complaints; opens are context only

baseline.source: get_flow_report on the live Trial onboarding flow, last 90 days, delivered-weighted

measurement.target: beat the old flow on its own numbers: a delivered-weighted click rate above 6.7% and a first-booking conversion rate above 7.3%, with no email above 1% unsubscribes
measurement.judge_after: 500 delivered per email or 2 weeks, whichever is later
measurement.first_test: email 1, subject A (benefit) against subject C (specific step), split 50/50
measurement.winner_rule: the subject with the higher click rate once each side has at least 500 delivered and at least 2 weeks have passed; until both are true, no winner is called and both subjects keep sending
measurement.time_to_judge: at about 770 trials a month split two ways, each side passes 500 delivered in about 39 days, so the 500-delivered rule decides, not the 2 weeks

unknowns: Whether unsubscribes are suppressed at once and whether the sending domain is authenticated: not readable through the API.
Why Turn on reminders in the live flow sends to no one: the report shows 0 recipients, not the cause.
The subject lines of the top 3 campaigns: Klaviyo reports don't carry them.
